ms.criteria:
The test version of the game will be launched. The community will be able to enter the game to experience on the web browser and PC. The features that will be included in this test are:
1. Campaign: this is the basic game mode for players to upgrade warriors and receive rewards through the levels
2. Expedition: Players will fight bosses. There are 2 modes that calculate the result according to the damage and the number of monsters killed
3. Breeding: Combine 2 heroes to create a new hero
4. Ascension: Combine 3 heroes to upgrade into a more advanced hero
5. Saga's skill tree: Skill system suit
ms.report:
Web browser, PC and Mobile main-net version were launched (on BSC). The community can enter the game to experience on the web browser, PC and mobile. The features included in this version are:
1. Campaign: this is the basic game mode for players to upgrade warriors and receive rewards through the levels
2. Expedition: Players will fight bosses. There are 2 modes that calculate the result according to the damage and the number of monsters killed
3. Breeding: Combine 2 heroes to create a new hero
4. Ascension: Combine 3 heroes to upgrade into a more advanced hero
5. Saga's skill tree: Skill system suitable for each player's strategy
